issues: Content section boxes do not align to the same horizontal edges as the /networking testimonial box when measured side-by-side at 1280px.

action_items: Adjust program content card width/alignment so the visible card boxes match the /networking card edges at the same viewport size, likely by letting the card fill the max-w-7xl wrapper content width instead of constraining it to max-w-6xl.
Keep the spacing change and background='plain' cardWrapClass behavior, which were verified in code/UI.
critical_code_review_comments: Blocks.js cardWrapClass(background) correctly returns an empty string for background === 'plain', and boxed backgrounds still include rounded-3xl, shadow-lg, and border classes.
The current max-w-6xl class on TextBlock/TestimonialBlock is the reason the program cards are still 96px inset from each side compared with /networking's visible card at 1280px.
Unrelated uncommitted frontend/yarn.lock changes are present in git status; they were not part of this focused UI bug verification.

Use viewport 1280x900 and compare [data-testid='program-text-block'] > div > div on /programs/next-generation-general-counsel against the visible Ann Kappler testimonial card on /networking. rca_of_the_issue: The fix increased program cards from max-w-5xl to max-w-6xl, which improves width but still imposes a 1152px max width. The /networking reference card has no equivalent max-width on the visible white box and fills the max-w-7xl wrapper's content width, so the user-visible boxes still do not match. Spacing improved: first section bottom padding is 40px and second section top padding is 40px at 1280px, giving an 80px card-to-card gap instead of the previous larger py-10/md:py-14 rhythm. Plain card support is present in source via cardWrapClass returning ''.
